text: The effectivity of IPT in treating depression has been thoroughly evaluated ( 14 ) and IPT is among the recommended treatments for depression in international practice guidelines ( 15 ). IPT has also proved effective in treating anxiety disorders ( 16 ). Globally, IPT has been applied to highly diverse patient populations in a variety therapeutic settings ( 17 ).
source_label: Tailoring interpersonal psychotherapy to psycho-oncology patients (TIPTOP): feasibility study protocol
